INSERT INTO contracts ( contract_id, contract_start_date, contract_end_date, total_budget, payment_method, contract_status, origin_contract_url, platform_contract_url, ai_report_url, contracted_at, completed_at, cancel_reason, client_rating, client_experience, client_is_renewal_intended, freelancer_rating, freelancer_experience ) VALUES ( #{contractId}, #{contract.contractStartDate}, #{contract.contractEndDate}, #{contract.totalBudget}, #{contract.paymentMethod}, #{contract.contractStatus}, #{contract.originContractUrl}, #{contract.platformContractUrl}, #{contract.aiReportUrl}, #{contract.contractedAt}, #{contract.completedAt}, #{contract.cancelReason}, #{contract.clientRating}, #{contract.clientExperience}, #{contract.clientIsRenewalIntended}, #{contract.freelancerRating}, #{contract.freelancerExperience} )
SELECT #{contractId}
mapper.select: SELECT contract_id as contractId, contract_start_date as contractStartDate, contract_end_date as contractEndDate, total_budget as totalBudget, payment_method as paymentMethod, contract_status as contractStatus, origin_contract_url as originContractUrl, platform_contract_url as platformContractUrl, ai_report_url as aiReportUrl, contracted_at as contractedAt, completed_at as completedAt, cancel_reason as cancelReason, client_rating as clientRating, client_experience as clientExperience, client_is_renewal_intended as clientIsRenewalIntended, freelancer_rating as freelancerRating, freelancer_experience as freelancerExperience FROM contracts WHERE contract_id = #{contractId}
SELECT origin_contract_url FROM contracts WHERE origin_contract_url LIKE #{pathPattern} AND origin_contract_url IS NOT NULL AND origin_contract_url != ''

SELECT c.contract_id as contractId, c.contract_start_date as contractStartDate, c.contract_end_date as contractEndDate, c.total_budget as totalBudget, c.payment_method as paymentMethod, c.contract_status as contractStatus, c.origin_contract_url as originContractUrl, c.platform_contract_url as platformContractUrl, c.ai_report_url as aiReportUrl, c.contracted_at as contractedAt, c.completed_at as completedAt, c.cancel_reason as cancelReason, c.client_rating as clientRating, c.client_experience as clientExperience, c.client_is_renewal_intended as clientIsRenewalIntended, c.freelancer_rating as freelancerRating, c.freelancer_experience as freelancerExperience FROM contracts c -- origin_contract_url에서 projectId 추출하여 projects 테이블과 조인 -- 경로 형식: contracts/{clientId}/{projectId}/{freelancerId}/... -- SUBSTRING_INDEX로 경로의 3번째 부분(projectId) 추출 INNER JOIN projects p ON CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(c.origin_contract_url, '/', 3), '/', -1) AS UNSIGNED) = p.project_id WHERE p.client_id = #{clientId} AND p.project_id = #{projectId} AND c.contract_status != 'TERMINATED' -- 경로 패턴 일치 확인: contracts/{clientId}/{projectId}/{freelancerId}/... AND c.origin_contract_url LIKE CONCAT('contracts/', #{clientId}, '/', #{projectId}, '/', #{freelancerId}, '/%') -- 경로의 4번째 부분(freelancerId) 추출하여 비교 AND CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(c.origin_contract_url, '/', 4), '/', -1) AS UNSIGNED) = #{freelancerId} ORDER BY c.contract_id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE contracts SET contract_start_date = #{contract.contractStartDate}, contract_end_date = #{contract.contractEndDate}, total_budget = #{contract.totalBudget}, payment_method = #{contract.paymentMethod}, contract_status = #{contract.contractStatus}, origin_contract_url = #{contract.originContractUrl}, platform_contract_url = #{contract.platformContractUrl}, ai_report_url = #{contract.aiReportUrl}, completed_at = #{contract.completedAt}, cancel_reason = #{contract.cancelReason}, client_rating = #{contract.clientRating}, client_experience = #{contract.clientExperience}, client_is_renewal_intended = #{contract.clientIsRenewalIntended}, freelancer_rating = #{contract.freelancerRating}, freelancer_experience = #{contract.freelancerExperience} WHERE contract_id = #{contract.contractId}
mapper.select: SELECT contract_id as contractId, contract_start_date as contractStartDate, contract_end_date as contractEndDate, total_budget as totalBudget, payment_method as paymentMethod, contract_status as contractStatus, origin_contract_url as originContractUrl, platform_contract_url as platformContractUrl, ai_report_url as aiReportUrl, contracted_at as contractedAt, completed_at as completedAt, cancel_reason as cancelReason, client_rating as clientRating, client_experience as clientExperience, client_is_renewal_intended as clientIsRenewalIntended, freelancer_rating as freelancerRating, freelancer_experience as freelancerExperience FROM contracts WHERE origin_contract_url LIKE #{pathPattern} ORDER BY contract_id DESC

SELECT contract_id as contractId, contract_start_date as contractStartDate, contract_end_date as contractEndDate, total_budget as totalBudget, payment_method as paymentMethod, contract_status as contractStatus, origin_contract_url as originContractUrl, platform_contract_url as platformContractUrl, ai_report_url as aiReportUrl, contracted_at as contractedAt, completed_at as completedAt, cancel_reason as cancelReason, client_rating as clientRating, client_experience as clientExperience, client_is_renewal_intended as clientIsRenewalIntended, freelancer_rating as freelancerRating, freelancer_experience as freelancerExperience FROM contracts ORDER BY contract_id DESC

SELECT -- Contract 정보 c.contract_id as contractId, c.contract_start_date as contractStartDate, c.contract_end_date as contractEndDate, c.total_budget as totalBudget, c.payment_method as paymentMethod, c.contract_status as contractStatus, c.origin_contract_url as originContractUrl, c.platform_contract_url as platformContractUrl, c.ai_report_url as aiReportUrl, c.contracted_at as contractedAt, c.completed_at as completedAt, c.cancel_reason as cancelReason, c.client_rating as clientRating, c.client_experience as clientExperience, c.client_is_renewal_intended as clientIsRenewalIntended, c.freelancer_rating as freelancerRating, c.freelancer_experience as freelancerExperience, -- Project 정보 (필요한 필드만) p.project_id as projectId, p.title as projectTitle, p.description as projectDescription, p.start_date as projectStartDate, p.deadline_date as projectDeadlineDate, p.est_duration as projectEstDuration, p.budget as projectBudget, p.communicate_method as projectCommunicateMethod, p.payment_method as projectPaymentMethod, -- Freelancer 정보 (필요한 필드만) fu.user_id as freelancerId, fu.name as freelancerName, fu.email as freelancerEmail, -- Client 정보 (필요한 필드만) cu.user_id as clientId, cu.name as clientName, cu.email as clientEmail, cu.phone as clientPhone, -- Company 정보 (필요한 필드만) co.company_name as companyName FROM contracts c -- 프로젝트 정보 조인 LEFT JOIN projects p ON c.origin_contract_url IS NOT NULL AND c.origin_contract_url LIKE 'contracts/%/%/%' AND CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(c.origin_contract_url, '/', 3), '/', -1) AS UNSIGNED) = p.project_id -- 프리랜서 사용자 정보 조인 LEFT JOIN users fu ON c.origin_contract_url IS NOT NULL AND c.origin_contract_url LIKE 'contracts/%/%/%' AND CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(c.origin_contract_url, '/', 4), '/', -1) AS UNSIGNED) = fu.user_id AND fu.user_type = 'FREELANCER' -- 클라이언트 사용자 정보 조인 LEFT JOIN users cu ON p.client_id = cu.user_id AND cu.user_type = 'CLIENT' -- 클라이언트 프로필 정보 조인 LEFT JOIN client_profiles cp ON cu.user_id = cp.client_id -- 회사 정보 조인 LEFT JOIN companies co ON cp.company_id = co.company_id WHERE c.contract_id = #{contractId}

SELECT -- Contract 정보 c.contract_id as contractId, c.contract_start_date as contractStartDate, c.contract_end_date as contractEndDate, c.total_budget as totalBudget, c.payment_method as paymentMethod, c.contract_status as contractStatus, c.origin_contract_url as originContractUrl, c.platform_contract_url as platformContractUrl, c.ai_report_url as aiReportUrl, c.contracted_at as contractedAt, c.completed_at as completedAt, c.cancel_reason as cancelReason, c.client_rating as clientRating, c.client_experience as clientExperience, c.client_is_renewal_intended as clientIsRenewalIntended, c.freelancer_rating as freelancerRating, c.freelancer_experience as freelancerExperience, -- Project 정보 p.title as projectTitle, -- Freelancer 정보 fu.name as freelancerName, -- Client 정보 cu.name as clientName, -- 마일스톤 상태 집계 (새로 추가) COALESCE(ms.total_milestones, 0) as totalMilestones, COALESCE(ms.paid_milestones, 0) as paidMilestones, COALESCE(ms.requested_milestones, 0) as requestedMilestones, COALESCE(ms.deposited_milestones, 0) as depositedMilestones, COALESCE(ms.waiting_milestones, 0) as waitingMilestones FROM contracts c -- 프로젝트 정보 조인 LEFT JOIN projects p ON c.origin_contract_url IS NOT NULL AND c.origin_contract_url LIKE 'contracts/%/%/%' AND CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(c.origin_contract_url, '/', 3), '/', -1) AS UNSIGNED) = p.project_id -- 프리랜서 정보 조인 LEFT JOIN users fu ON c.origin_contract_url IS NOT NULL AND c.origin_contract_url LIKE 'contracts/%/%/%' AND CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(c.origin_contract_url, '/', 4), '/', -1) AS UNSIGNED) = fu.user_id AND fu.user_type = 'FREELANCER' -- 클라이언트 정보 조인 LEFT JOIN users cu ON p.client_id = cu.user_id AND cu.user_type = 'CLIENT' -- 마일스톤 상태 집계 서브쿼리 (LEFT JOIN) LEFT JOIN ( SELECT contract_id, COUNT(*) as total_milestones, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'PAID' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as paid_milestones, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'REQUESTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as requested_milestones, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'DEPOSITED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as deposited_milestones, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'WAITING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as waiting_milestones FROM contract_milestones GROUP BY contract_id ) ms ON c.contract_id = ms.contract_id ORDER BY c.contract_id DESC
